specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Extended Buff Range
specialRules.description: Only one use per game. If this unit is within 24" of another friendly unit with this rule that is within 6" of a friendly Hero, then that Hero may use special rules that allow it to pick friendly units within 12" (except for spells) on this unit as if it was in range.

specialRules.name: Increased Shooting Range
specialRules.description: This model gets +6" range when shooting.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Shadowborn
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Shadowborn, attackers always get -4"/-2" range when targeting it from Shadowborn (instead of only the first time they are attacked each round).

specialRules.name: Armor
specialRules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Rapid Rush
specialRules.description: This model moves +6" when using Rush actions.

specialRules.name: Shadowborn
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy, as long as this unit hasn't started an activation yet this round, attackers get -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6" when shooting/charging it.

specialRules.name: Ravage
specialRules.description: Once per round, when it’s this model’s turn to strike in melee, roll X dice before attacking, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

specialRules.name: Regeneration Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Regeneration. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Thrust in Melee
specialRules.description: This model gets Thrust in melee.

specialRules.name: Counter in Melee
specialRules.description: This model gets Counter in melee.

specialRules.name: Bounding
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

specialRules.name: Enhanced Shadowborn Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Shadowborn. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Ignores Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Precision Target
specialRules.description: Only one use per game. Once per game, during this model's activation, pick X enemy units within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place one token on them. Friendly units get +1 to hit rolls when attacking them.

specialRules.name: Dodge
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they aren't Fatigued, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls in melee against them.

specialRules.name: Melee Slayer
specialRules.description: This model's melee weapons get AP(+2) against units where most models have Tough(9) or higher.

specialRules.name: Demolish
specialRules.description: Ignores Cover, and when attacking units with most models within 1" of terrain, this weapon gets AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Ignores Regeneration
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter Mark
specialRules.description: Only one use per game. Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unpredictable Fighter against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Shrouded
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Shrouded, attackers always get -4"/-2" range when targeting it from Shrouded (instead of only the first time they are attacked each round).

specialRules.name: Shrouded
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy, as long as this unit hasn't started an activation yet this round, attackers get -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6" when shooting/charging it.

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be placed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units.

specialRules.name: Hero
specialRules.description: Units within 6” of friendly Heroes may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Thrust
specialRules.description: When charging, gets +1 to hit rolls and AP(+1) in melee.

specialRules.name: Counter
specialRules.description: May strike first with this weapon when charged, unless this unit is Fatigued.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable
specialRules.description: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Deadly
specialRules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.
